_comment: Corrections applied last, over everything the APIs return. Keyed by Jolpica id; any field of a driver or team in public/data can be set (nested objects merge, e.g. { "career": { "poles": 104 } }). Examples: a team's "colour" ("#RRGGBB"), a driver's "photo" (formula1.com media path, or null to hide it), a "bio".
